name: Kann
source:
Iris' friend from Purifier school who works as her mechanic. Kann often works late into the night to triple check her work, as a certain accident traumatized her into being a perfectionist.

Since then, she's become more outspoken especially when it comes to safety, but tends to be too harsh on herself.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12574301.kann]official bio[/url]]
